summary: Social-first glance: vendor releases (Anthropic, Google) and multiple security/user-workflow threads dominate discussion; operator posts call for better registries, memory and sandboxing. | Vendor announcements and engineering posts showing momentum in agent tooling, containment/security, MCP/storage primitives, and operator onboarding (Cloudflare/Supabase). | GitHub OSS snapshot: active agent frameworks and infra updates (Dify, Mastra, Omnigent, Kubernetes agent-sandbox); many repo-first operator tools but few social field reports — repo-only signals need corroboration. | Package-registry signals show growing agent infra (memory, MCP, sandboxes, detection) plus vendor VS Code/browser agents; lacking social/workflow reports for operator impact.
